findings.impact: Legitimate files containing ignore pattern substrings are incorrectly excluded from the dependency graph.
findings.evidence: repo-graph.ps1 lines 85-100: IgnorePatterns include .git, .aura; matching is substring wildcard.
findings.recommended_fix: Use path prefix matching for directory-level patterns, or add path separator boundaries to regex

findings.problem: GS-01 test creates user files in $testDir outside $ProjectRoot, then attempts git operations on those paths relative to $ProjectRoot. Git commands target wrong paths.
findings.root_cause: $userFile = Join-Path $testDir creates file in temp parent dir, but git -C $ProjectRoot reset -- $userFile passes a path not inside the repo.
findings.impact: GS-01 scenario is always broken: git operations target paths outside the repo root. Misleading test results.
findings.evidence: git-safety-adversarial.ps1 lines 60-80: Path mismatch causes all git commands to fail or no-op.
findings.recommended_fix: Create test files inside $ProjectRoot or compute relative paths correctly for git operations

findings.problem: Module loading classifies any module not in required/optional/experimental lists as REQUIRED. Blocks convergence when adding new modules.
findings.root_cause: foreach loop falls through to default case which calls modRequiredFailures for unclassified modules
findings.impact: A benign module addition that is not classified blocks the convergence gate, creating a spurious blocker.
findings.evidence: run-audit.ps1 lines 1799-1816: module loading switch falls through to default for unclassified modules.
findings.recommended_fix: Treat unclassified modules as optional (warning only) or add an explicit unclassified category

findings.problem: Stale proposed cleanup test creates files and checks their LastWriteTime, but files are just created so LastWriteTime is now. Content timestamp is -2h but detection uses actual file metadata.
findings.root_cause: $staleTime = (Get-Date).AddHours(-2) is written to content, but detection checks actual file LastWriteTime (now since file was just created).
findings.impact: Stale proposed file detection has a false-negative. The self-test validates a broken scenario.
findings.evidence: failure-recovery.ps1 lines 861-884: content timestamp is set to -2h but detection uses actual file LastWriteTime.
findings.recommended_fix: Fix the test to use Set-ItemProperty to modify the actual LastWriteTime

findings.problem: promote-state performs non-atomic three-phase write (findings, convergence, cycle). Crash between writes causes inconsistent partial-promotion state.
findings.root_cause: Three separate Write-JsonFile calls without any transactional bundling, rollback mechanism, or write-ahead log.
findings.impact: Partial promotion after crash: findings and convergence updated but cycle not. Irrecoverable inconsistency.
findings.evidence: run-audit.ps1 lines 2565-2578: three sequential writes with no atomicity guarantee.
findings.recommended_fix: Write to temporary files, validate all three parse correctly, then atomically rename all three in sequence

findings.problem: False evidence and adversarial campaign tests write to the real evidence registry instead of using a test copy. Fake attack artifacts permanently pollute the engine evidence trail.
findings.root_cause: Both modules call Register-Evidence against the real registry path without creating a test-isolated copy.
findings.impact: Engine evidence registry accumulates fabricated attack artifacts. Registry becomes untrustworthy for real audit evidence.
findings.evidence: false-evidence-attacks.ps1 line 38: regPath points to real registry. adversarial-campaign.ps1 writes directly to real registry.
findings.recommended_fix: Create a test-specific evidence registry copy before the campaign and restore after

findings.problem: FCX module_load_status always hardcoded to true without actually verifying module loading.
findings.root_cause: validators_available = true; evidence_engine = true always set regardless of actual module state.
findings.impact: False convergence campaign reports validators available even when modules failed to load.
findings.evidence: false-convergence-extended.ps1 lines 62-97: validator checks precede module_load_status assignment, but status is hardcoded.
findings.recommended_fix: Set module_load_status based on actual availability checks performed at lines 62-68

findings.problem: Invoke-SandboxCommand always reports exit_code=0 for successful commands. PowerShell jobs do not propagate exit codes from Invoke-Expression. Also blends stdout and stderr.
findings.root_cause: exit_code hardcoded to 0 for success. Receive-Job captures both streams merged. Spaces_escape_detected always false.
findings.impact: Sandbox provides false exit code information. No stdout/stderr separation. No real process isolation.
findings.evidence: sandbox.ps1: exit_code hardcoded 0. Self-test says jobs do not propagate exit codes.
findings.recommended_fix: Use Start-Process with RedirectStandardOutput/RedirectStandardError for proper exit code capture

findings.problem: GS-08 git check-ignore logic is inverted. git check-ignore returns exit code 0 when a file IS ignored, but code sets trackedByGit=true when exit code is 0.
findings.root_cause: git check-ignore returns exit code 0 for ignored files, exit code 1 for tracked files. Code misattributes exit code meaning.
findings.impact: GS-08 credential leak scenario may report false negative due to inverted git check-ignore logic
findings.evidence: git-safety-adversarial.ps1 lines 375-379: if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $trackedByGit = $true }.
findings.recommended_fix: Invert the exit code check or use git ls-files --error-unmatch for explicit tracking detection
